'''Tatooine bug juice''' was a beverage made from bugs found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The drink was sold by [[Tyrral]] from [[Tyrral's Mercantile|his shop]] on [[Station Gamma]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:SG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Station Gamma}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tatooine bug juice appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SG" /> prior to the game's closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tatooine bug juice was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref> In the game, it increased the agility of players.<ref name="SWG:SG" />
